note: Demo Sessions are synthetic. They were produced by the Anonymizer (scripts/anonymize.ts): every free-text string, path and name was replaced with same-length placeholder text, while Record order, Record types and the Measured Tokens of every API Call were kept exactly. The token dynamics are real; none of the words are.

sessions.name: Small session
sessions.description: Five API Calls in a 200k window. Almost two thirds of it is System, so it shows what a session costs before any work happens.

sessions.name: Medium session
sessions.description: Sixty-two API Calls filling half a 200k window, and the only Demo Session in which all six Categories are present, memory files included.

sessions.name: Large session
sessions.description: Two hundred sixty-one API Calls in a 1M window, with four compactions along the way: the context drops and attribution restarts from each summary.
